metadata.question: Does vegetation greenness (NDVI) in Toliara, Madagascar on average decrease during September 2021-2022 compared to the 2000-2015 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Toliara, Madagascar (approximately -23.35, 43.67) - Two time periods: September 2000-2015 (baseline) and September 2021-2022 (comparison) - Collection: MODIS NDVI (MOD13Q1 or MOD13A1) for long-term consistent data - Alternative: Landsat for backup 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality flags to mask poor quality pixels - MODIS has quality bands to filter clouds and invalid data - Question is about vegetation greenness, so mask clouds/bad pixels 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid NDVI range: -1 to 1, but for vegetation typically 0 to 1 - Check if pixel count > 0 after masking - Compare means: if baseline > comparison, answer is A (Yes, decrease) - If baseline <= comparison, answer is B (No decrease) - Handle C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (null/invalid results) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions toliara = ee.Geometry.Point([43.67, -23.35]) region = toliara.buffer(10000) # 10km buffer # Define time periods - September only baseline_start = '2000-09-01' baseline_end = '2015-09-30' comparison_start = '2021-09-01' comparison_end = '2022-09-30' # 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS NDVI def mask_modis_quality(image): qa = image.select('SummaryQA') # Keep only good quality pixels (0 = good) mask = qa.eq(0) return image.updateMask(mask) # Baseline period (2000-2015 September) baseline_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') \ .filterBounds(region) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(9, 9, 'month')) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2000, 2015, 'year')) \ .map(mask_modis_quality) \ .select('NDVI') baseline_size = baseline_col.size().getInfo() print(f"Baseline (Sep 2000-2015) images: {baseline_size}") if baseline_size == 0: print("No baseline data found.") print("C1") exit() # Comparison period (2021-2022 September) comparison_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') \ .filterBounds(region) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(9, 9, 'month')) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2021, 2022, 'year')) \ .map(mask_modis_quality) \ .select('NDVI') comparison_size = comparison_col.size().getInfo() print(f"Comparison (Sep 2021-2022) images: {comparison_size}") if comparison_size == 0: print("No comparison data found.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Calculate mean NDVI for each period baseline_mean = baseline_col.mean() comparison_mean = comparison_col.mean() # 4. Get statistics with pixel count validation baseline_stats = baseline_mean.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=region, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9 ).getInfo() comparison_stats = comparison_mean.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=region, scale=250, maxPixels=1e9 ).getInfo() baseline_ndvi = baseline_stats.get('NDVI_mean') baseline_count = baseline_stats.get('NDVI_count') comparison_ndvi = comparison_stats.get('NDVI_mean') comparison_count = comparison_stats.get('NDVI_count') print(f"Baseline NDVI mean: {baseline_ndvi}, Pixels: {baseline_count}") print(f"Comparison NDVI mean: {comparison_ndvi}, Pixels: {comparison_count}") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if baseline_count == 0 or comparison_count == 0: print("No valid pixels after masking.") print("C2") elif baseline_ndvi is None or comparison_ndvi is None: print("Calculation returned None.") print("C3") elif baseline_ndvi < -1 or baseline_ndvi > 1 or comparison_ndvi < -1 or comparison_ndvi > 1: print("Invalid NDVI range detected.") print("C3") else: # MODIS NDVI is scaled by 10000, so divide baseline_ndvi_scaled = baseline_ndvi / 10000 comparison_ndvi_scaled = comparison_ndvi / 10000 print(f"Baseline NDVI (scaled): {baseline_ndvi_scaled:.4f}") print(f"Comparison NDVI (scaled): {comparison_ndvi_scaled:.4f}") print(f"Change: {comparison_ndvi_scaled - baseline_ndvi_scaled:.4f}") if baseline_ndvi_scaled > comparison_ndvi_scaled: print("Vegetation greenness decreased.") print("A") else: print("Vegetation greenness did not decrease.") print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
toliara = ee.Geometry.Point([43.67, -23.35])
region = toliara.buffer(10000)  # 10km buffer

# Define time periods - September only
baseline_start = '2000-09-01'
baseline_end = '2015-09-30'
comparison_start = '2021-09-01'
comparison_end = '2022-09-30'

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS NDVI
def mask_modis_quality(image):
    qa = image.select('SummaryQA')
    # Keep only good quality pixels (0 = good)
    mask = qa.eq(0)
    return image.updateMask(mask)

# Baseline period (2000-2015 September)
baseline_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') \
    .filterBounds(region) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(9, 9, 'month')) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2000, 2015, 'year')) \
    .map(mask_modis_quality) \
    .select('NDVI')

baseline_size = baseline_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"Baseline (Sep 2000-2015) images: {baseline_size}")

if baseline_size == 0:
    print("No baseline data found.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# Comparison period (2021-2022 September)
comparison_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') \
    .filterBounds(region) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(9, 9, 'month')) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2021, 2022, 'year')) \
    .map(mask_modis_quality) \
    .select('NDVI')

comparison_size = comparison_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"Comparison (Sep 2021-2022) images: {comparison_size}")

if comparison_size == 0:
    print("No comparison data found.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Calculate mean NDVI for each period
baseline_mean = baseline_col.mean()
comparison_mean = comparison_col.mean()

# 4. Get statistics with pixel count validation
baseline_stats = baseline_mean.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
    geometry=region,
    scale=250,
    maxPixels=1e9
).getInfo()

comparison_stats = comparison_mean.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
    geometry=region,
    scale=250,
    maxPixels=1e9
).getInfo()

baseline_ndvi = baseline_stats.get('NDVI_mean')
baseline_count = baseline_stats.get('NDVI_count')
comparison_ndvi = comparison_stats.get('NDVI_mean')
comparison_count = comparison_stats.get('NDVI_count')

print(f"Baseline NDVI mean: {baseline_ndvi}, Pixels: {baseline_count}")
print(f"Comparison NDVI mean: {comparison_ndvi}, Pixels: {comparison_count}")

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
if baseline_count == 0 or comparison_count == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif baseline_ndvi is None or comparison_ndvi is None:
    print("Calculation returned None.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif baseline_ndvi < -1 or baseline_ndvi > 1 or comparison_ndvi < -1 or comparison_ndvi > 1:
    print("Invalid NDVI range detected.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    # MODIS NDVI is scaled by 10000, so divide
    baseline_ndvi_scaled = baseline_ndvi / 10000
    comparison_ndvi_scaled = comparison_ndvi / 10000
    
    print(f"Baseline NDVI (scaled): {baseline_ndvi_scaled:.4f}")
    print(f"Comparison NDVI (scaled): {comparison_ndvi_scaled:.4f}")
    print(f"Change: {comparison_ndvi_scaled - baseline_ndvi_scaled:.4f}")
    
    if baseline_ndvi_scaled > comparison_ndvi_scaled:
        print("Vegetation greenness decreased.")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("Vegetation greenness did not decrease.")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
